task.description: You are on branch feature/WF03-ISS0392-20260901 (checkout/pull it first). Run the security gate against this run's diff: git diff main...HEAD -- lib/. ELIXIR-DEV's change (commit e30873f8) is entirely within lib/letflow/engine.ex, touching build_complete_task_tail_multi/6 and build_task_activation_and_reconciliation_multi/3 (now /4) plus a new private helper maybe_append_task_activation_multi/7 -- a fix for an Ecto.Multi :task_records key collision (ISS-0392) that, when a SUB_PROCESS child completes synchronously, currently either raises a 500 (unfixed) or, per the fix, conditionally omits one of two duplicate task-activation Multi steps for the same instance_id. This IS a tenant-data write path per your scope test (task-record creation/reconciliation within a tenant-scoped hop-chain transaction). Run the scope test explicitly, then evaluate every one of INV-1 through INV-8 per security-invariants.md against the actual diff -- pay particular attention to whether the conditional omission of a task-activation step could ever cause a tenant's task record to be silently dropped/never-created (as opposed to correctly deferred to the other call site that supersedes it) for any real code path, since that would be a data-integrity/tenant-isolation concern even though the fix's OWN safety argument (design doc SS2.3-SS2.4) already claims this can't happen.
acceptance_criteria: Scope test explicitly run and its verdict stated
Every one of INV-1..INV-8 given an explicit APPLIES/NOT-APPLICABLE verdict against the actual diff
Every APPLIES invariant's 'How to verify' procedure actually run, with PASS/FAIL recorded

Independently assessed whether the skip_task_activation? conditional could ever cause a real tenant's task-activation step to be dropped entirely (not just deferred) -- not merely trusting the design doc's own safety claim
Single FAIL on any applicable invariant terminates with status FAIL, no partial credit
